title: Jubilees 5 — The Watchers, the giants, and the Flood

paragraphs.text: ויהי כי החלו בני האדם לרב על פני האדמה ובנות נולדו להם וירואו מלאכי האלהים בשנה אחת ביובל הזה כי טובות הן ויקחו להם נשים מכל אשר בחרו ותלדנה להם בנים והמה הגיברים
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī kī hēḥēllū bənē hā-ʾādām lā-rōb ʿal pənē hā-ʾădāmāh ū-bānōt nōlədū lā-hem wa-yirʾū malʾăkē hā-ʾĕlōhīm bə-šānāh ʾaḥat ba-yōbēl ha-zeh kī ṭōbōt hēn wa-yiqqəḥū lā-hem nāšīm mi-kol ʾăšer bāḥărū wa-tēlaḏnāh lā-hem bānīm wə-hēmmāh ha-gibbōrīm

i18n.en: And it came to pass when the sons of men began to multiply upon the face of the earth, and daughters were born to them, that the angels of God saw them in a certain year of this jubilee that they were beautiful; and they took for themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bore them sons — and these were the mighty ones.

paragraphs.commentary: The compressed Watchers narrative parallel to 1 En 6-11. Hebrew-primary via 11Q12 fragment. Jubilees uses 'angels of God' (malake el) rather than 'sons of God' (bnei elohim) — a deliberate disambiguation preserving angelic identity.

paragraphs.text: ወረሥሐት፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእስከ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኀደጉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትበላዕ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ ወአበሰ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ኂሩተ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኮነ፡ እኩየ፡ ዘልፈ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-rasḥat kwəlu śəgā fənoto ʾəm-nə sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska ʾarāwit wa-ʾəska ʾaʿwāf wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr kwəlomu ḫadagu śərʿatomu wa-ʾaḫazu yətballāʿ ʾaḥadu kāləʾo wa-ʾabasa ʿamaḍā lāʿla mədr wa-kwəlu ḫəllinā-hu la-kwəlu ḥirūta daqiqa sabʾ kona ʾəkkuya zalfa

i18n.en: And all flesh corrupted its way — from men, even to cattle, and to beasts, and to birds, and to everything that moves upon the earth; they all abandoned their proper order, and began to devour one another. And lawlessness increased upon the earth, and every thought of all the imagination of the sons of men was continually evil.

paragraphs.text: ወሤመ፡ እግዚእ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወአንሰ፡ አስተራኢ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ካልአ፡ ምስለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ለመዋዕል፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኅሉፋን፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ዓመተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śēma ʾəgziʾ manfasa lāʿla kwəlu sabʾ wa-ʾansa ʾastarāʾi lāʿla kwəlu śəgā ʾəmdəḫrazə kidāna kāləʾa məsla sabʾ la-mawāʿəl kwəlomu ḫəlufān məʾət wa-ʿaśrā ʿāmata

i18n.en: And the Lord set his judgment upon all, and he was displeased with all flesh; and after that he made another covenant with men: that the days of all who should remain should be one hundred and twenty years.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አኀዝት፡ ምድር፡ ለመውዓ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ዘፈጠርኩ፡ እምሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወአዕዋፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ እስመ፡ ነስሕኩ፡ ከመ፡ ገበርክዎሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾ ʾaḫaztu mədr la-mawʿā sabʾ ʾəm-nə gaṣṣa mədr za-faṭarku ʾəm-sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr wa-ʾaʿwāfa samāy ʾəsma nashku kama gabarkəwomu

i18n.en: And the Lord said: I shall blot out man and all flesh that I have created from the face of the earth — man and cattle, and everything that creeps upon the earth, and the birds of the heavens — for I have repented that I made them.

paragraphs.text: ወአምልክት፡ ኖኅ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ እግዚእ፡ ብርየ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ጻድቅ፡ በትውልዱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ፍጹም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾamləkta Noḫ qədma gaṣṣa ʾəgziʾ bərya wa-bəʾəsi ṣādəq ba-təwludu bəʾəsi fəṣṣum

i18n.en: But Noah found favor before the eyes of the Lord; and he was a righteous man and perfect in his generation.

paragraphs.text: ወላዕለ፡ መላእክቲሁ፡ ኒሁ፡ እለ፡ ፈነወ፡ ኀበ፡ ምድር፡ ተምዕዐ፡ ጥቀ፡ ከመ፡ ይሰምኦሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወሤሞሙ፡ ኀቤነ፡ ከመ፡ ናሰስሎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ጥልቅ፡ ዓለም፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ኩናኔ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-lāʿla malāʾəktihu naḫu ʾəlla fanawa ḫaba mədr tamʿəʿa ṭəqqa kama yəssamʾomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu makānātihomu wa-śēmomu ḫabēna kama nāsasələmu wəsta ṭəlq ʿālam ʾəska ʿəlata ʿabəy kwənnānē

i18n.en: And against his angels — those whom he had sent upon the earth — he was greatly angered, so that he removed them from all their stations; and he commanded us to bind them in the depths of the earth, and behold, they are bound there until the day of the great judgment.

paragraphs.commentary: The binding of the Watchers 'in the depths of the earth' directly parallels 2 Pet 2:4 + Jude 6. The angel of the presence is identified as the executor of the binding.

paragraphs.text: ወላዕለ፡ ደቂቆሙ፡ ወፅአ፡ ቃል፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ከመ፡ ይትቀተሉ፡ በሰይፍ፡ ወከመ፡ ይስስሉ፡ እምነ፡ ታሕተ፡ ሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-lāʿla daqiqomu waḍʾa qāl ʾəm-nə qədma gaṣṣu kama yətqattalu ba-sayf wa-kama yəssaslu ʾəm-nə tāḥta samāy

i18n.en: And against their sons a word went forth from before his face: that they should be struck down with the sword and removed from under heaven.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤ፡ ኢይነብር፡ መንፈስየ፡ በሰብእ፡ ለዓለም፡ እስመ፡ ሥጋሰ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወይኩኑ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ ምእት፡ ወዕሥራ፡ ዓመተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbē ʾi-yənabbər manfasəya ba-sabʾ la-ʿālam ʾəsma śəgāsa ʾəmuntu wa-yəkunu mawāʿəlihomu məʾət wa-ʿaśrā ʿāmata

i18n.en: And he said: My spirit shall not abide in man forever, for they also are flesh; and their days shall be one hundred and twenty years.

paragraphs.text: ወፈነወ፡ ሰይፍ፡ በማእከሎሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበር፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ ሰይፈ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትቀተሉ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡ እስከ፡ ወድቁ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በሰይፍ፡ ወአስተአተቱ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-fanawa sayf ba-māʾkalomu kama yəgbar ʾaḥadu kāləʾo sayfa wa-ʾaḫazu yətqattalu ʾaḥadu kāləʾo ʾəska wadqu kwəlomu ba-sayf wa-ʾastaʾtatu ʾəm-nə mədr

i18n.en: And he sent a sword among them, that each should slay the other with the sword; and they began to kill one another, until they all fell by the sword and were destroyed from the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወአበዊሆሙ፡ ኮኑ፡ ይርእዩ፡ ወአስተአተቱ፡ እምድኅረዝ፡ በውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ወአስተአተቶሙ፡ ካዕበ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ዘገብሩ፡ እኩየ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾabawihomu konu yərʾəyu wa-ʾastaʾtatu ʾəmdəḫrazə ba-wəsta mədr ʾəm-nə qədma ʾəgziʾ wa-ʾastaʾtatomu kāʿba lāʿla kwəlu gəbər zagabru ʾəkkuya

i18n.en: And their fathers looked on while they were being destroyed; and after that they were bound in the earth from before the Lord, and he destroyed them again on account of all the evil deeds that they had done.

paragraphs.text: ወአስተአተቶሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ መካናቲሆሙ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘተርፈ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ዘኢመነኖ፡ በከመ፡ መንኖሙ፡ በከመ፡ መጠን፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾastaʾtatomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu makānātihomu wa-ʾalbo zatarfa ʾəmənnehomu zaʾi-mannano ba-kama mannanomu ba-kama maṭan kwəlu gəbromu

i18n.en: And he removed them from all their stations; and there was not one of them left whom he did not judge — according to the measure of all their deeds.

paragraphs.text: ወገብረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ሐዲሰ፡ ወርትዐ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኬሐሉ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ በኵሉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወከመ፡ ይኩኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃነ፡ በዘዘዚአሁ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ዘልፈ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-gabra lāʿla kwəlu gəbromu śərʿata ḥaddisa wa-rətʿa kama ʾi-yəkēḥalu la-ḫāṭiʾat ba-kwəlu śərʿatomu ʾəska la-ʿālam wa-kama yəkunu kwəlomu ṣādəqāna ba-zazazaʾahu gəʿz zalfa

i18n.en: And he made for all his works a new and righteous nature, that they should not sin in any of their order forever, but should all be righteous, each according to its own kind, continually.

paragraphs.text: ወፍትሐ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐቱ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ በከመ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ እምነ፡ ሕግ፡ ቦ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ ጽሑፋን፡ በከመ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ግብሮሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-fətḥa kwəlu śəgā ṣəḥuf lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ba-kama śərʿatu la-kwəlu gəbər ba-kama ṣədq wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw ʾəm-nə ḥəg bo wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw kwəlomu zawəstatēhā ṣəḥufan ba-kama kwəlomu gəbromu

i18n.en: And the judgment of all flesh is written on the heavenly tablets, according to its ordinance for every work, according to righteousness; and there is none who transgresses the law concerning him, nor is there any who escapes — they are all written in it according to all their deeds.

paragraphs.commentary: The heavenly tablets contain the judgments of all created beings — predestinarian framework. Bidirectional with v2.67.0 1 Enoch 81 heavenly-tablets entry.

paragraphs.text: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትኀደግ፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ለርእሰ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ለመጠን፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘረሰየ፡ ወባሕቱ፡ ሊቀ፡ መንፈስ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ጻድቅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾalbo zayətḫaddag ʾəm-nə qədma gaṣṣu kwəlu gəbər la-rəʾəsa kwənnānē la-maṭan kwəlu gəbru lāʿla kwəlu zarassaya wa-bāḥtu liqa manfas la-kwəlu ṣādəq

i18n.en: And there is nothing in heaven or on earth, or in light or in darkness, or in Sheol, or in the depths, or in the place of darkness, that is forsaken before his face. And all judgments are ordained according to all that he has appointed; and he is the chief of spirits for every righteous one.

paragraphs.text: ወይኤዝዝ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዐት፡ በፍትሕ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ ቃሎ፡ ለፈትዎ፡ ለነፍሱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡ ለመጠን፡ ዘገብረ፡ ለመጠን፡ ሙስና፡ ኮኖ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəʾēzəz lāʿla kwəlu śərʿat ba-fətḥ ṣədq wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw qālo la-fatwo la-nafsu wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw la-maṭan zagabra la-maṭan musnā kono

i18n.en: And he commands every ordinance with a righteous judgment; and there is none who transgresses his word with impunity, and none who can do what he has not appointed — according to the measure of what each has done, according to the measure of his guilt, is his recompense.

paragraphs.text: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይነሥእ፡ አርእስቶ፡ ዘዘዘ፡ እምነ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይነሥእ፡ ሕልዮ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይነሥእ፡ መልጥሕተ፡ ምንተ፡ ግብር፡ ዘጻድቅ፡ ወምንተ፡ ግብር፡ ዘርቱዕ፡ ወምንተ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘረሰየ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾalbo zayənaśśəʾ ʾarʾəsto zazaza ʾəm-nə kiyāhu wa-ʾalbo zayənaśśəʾ ḥəlyo wa-ʾalbo zayənaśśəʾ malṭəḥta mənta gəbər zaṣādəq wa-mənta gəbər zarətuʿ wa-mənta kwənnānē ṣādəq lāʿla kwəlu gəbər lāʿla kwəlu zarassaya

i18n.en: He is not one who takes account of persons, nor one who receives a gift — when he says he will execute judgment on each one; for whatever a man does, what is righteous and what is right, and what is righteous judgment — concerning every deed he has appointed.

paragraphs.text: ወወሀበ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ መዋዕለ፡ ስርየት፡ በዐመት፡ አሐዱ፡ ለትከውን፡ ሎሙ፡ ቤዛ፡ ለኀጢአቶሙ፡ በዕለት፡ ስርየት፡ ለትትከስት፡ ዐመፃ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wahabā la-ʾəsrāʾēl mawāʿəla səryat ba-ʿāmat ʾaḥadu la-tkawwən lomu bēzā la-ḫāṭiʾatomu ba-ʿəlat səryat la-tətkasat ʿamaḍā ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾatomu

i18n.en: And he gave to Israel days of atonement — one day in the year — that they might have an atonement for their sins; on the day of atonement, that they might be forgiven from all their iniquity.

paragraphs.commentary: The Yom Kippur etiology: Jubilees' foundational text for the atonement-mechanism. The day-of-atonement is established as the cosmic-judgment day where God forgives Israel.

paragraphs.text: ወእስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ይትፀመሙ፡ ለርእሰ፡ ይትዐቀቡ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትዐደው፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəska ʿəlata kwənnānē yətḍammamu la-rəʾəsa yətʿaqqabu kwəlomu ṣādəqāna ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat wa-ʾalbo zayətʿaddaw

i18n.en: And until the day of judgment, all the righteous shall keep themselves and guard themselves from every sin, and none shall transgress.

paragraphs.text: ወባሕቱ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ኀርየ፡ ወአንቅሐ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ለትከውን፡ ምድር፡ ብእሲተ፡ ምስለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለትከውን፡ ሕያው፡ በዘ፡ ሰብእ፡ ለመኲንን፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ዘሰላም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bāḥtu la-Noḫ ḫarya wa-ʾanqəḥa la-rəʾəsu la-tkawwən mədr bəʾəsita məsla Noḫ la-tkawwən ḥəyāw ba-za sabʾ la-makwannən ʾəm-nə qədma gaṣṣa kwənnānē zasalām

i18n.en: But Noah he chose and preserved for himself, that the earth might be a wife to Noah, and that she might live through him — that humanity might be ruled before the face of judgment with peace.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አጠፍኦ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘፈጠርኩ፡ ላዕለ፡ ገጸ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእስከ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ ነስሕኩ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbē ʾəgziʾ ʾaṭafəʾo la-kwəlu zafaṭarku lāʿla gaṣṣa mədr ʾəm-nə sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska ʾarāwit wa-ʾəska ʾaʿwāf wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr ʾəsma nashku

i18n.en: And the Lord said: I shall blot out all that I have made from the face of the earth — man and cattle and beasts and birds and everything that moves upon the earth — for I have repented that I made them.

paragraphs.text: ወአዘዞ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ይግበር፡ ሎቱ፡ ታቦተ፡ ከመ፡ ይድኅን፡ እምነ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾazazo la-Noḫ yəgbar lottu tābota kama yədḫən ʾəm-nə māya ʾāyəḫ

i18n.en: And he commanded Noah to make for himself an ark, that he might be saved from the waters of the flood.

paragraphs.text: ወገብረ፡ ኖኅ፡ ታቦተ፡ በኵሉ፡ በከመ፡ አዘዞ፡ በ፪ ኅምስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በራብዕ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዐመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዐመተ፡ ኅምስ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-gabra Noḫ tābota ba-kwəlu ba-kama ʾazazo ba-2 ḫəməs ʾiyobēləwu ba-rābəʿ sabuʿ ba-ʿamat qadāmāwi la-ʿāmata ḫəməsə

i18n.en: And Noah made the ark in every respect as he had commanded him, in the twenty-fifth jubilee of years, in the fourth week, in the first year of the fifth year.

paragraphs.text: ወቦአ፡ በሰዱስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዐመቱ፡ ዘሳድስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ውስተ፡ ታቦት፡ እስከ፡ ዐሥር፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ በ፪ ሰቡዕ፡ በ፪ ዓመት፡ በውእቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ ራብዕ፡ በ፲፮፡ ዕለት፡ ለወርኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-boʾa ba-sadus ʿāmat la-ʿamatu zasādəs sabuʿ wəsta tābot ʾəska ʿaśr ʾiyobēləwu ba-2 sabuʿ ba-2 ʿāmat ba-wəʾtu warḫ rābəʿ ba-16 ʿəlat la-warḫ

i18n.en: And he entered it in the sixth year of his life, in the sixth week, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month.

paragraphs.text: ወአርኀወ፡ ሰማይ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ማይ፡ ላዕሉ፡ ወማእምቃተ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ተአንኮስቱ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ እስከ፡ ኀምሳ፡ መዐምቃተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾarḫawa samāy ʾanqəʿta māy lāʿlu wa-māʾəmqāta ʿabayta taʾankostu ʾəm-nə mədr ʾəska ḫamsā maʿamqāta

i18n.en: And the heavens opened the springs of water above; and the great deeps were broken open from the earth — even unto the seven great deeps.

paragraphs.text: ወአርኀወ፡ ሰማይ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ወወሀበ፡ ዝናመ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ አርብዓ፡ መዓልተ፡ ወአርብዓ፡ ሌሊተ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾarḫawa samāy ʾanqəʿta wa-wahaba zənāma lāʿla mədr ʾarbəʿā maʿālta wa-ʾarbəʿā lēlita

i18n.en: And the heavens opened their springs, and gave rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

paragraphs.text: ወቆሙ፡ መዓምቃተ፡ ምድር፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እስከ፡ ዐሣ፡ ወምእት፡ መዓልት፡ ወቆመት፡ ምድር፡ ኵላ፡ ላዕለ፡ ገጻ፡ ለማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-qomu maʿamqāta mədr kwəlomu ʾəska ʿaśā wa-məʾət maʿālt wa-qomat mədr kwəlā lāʿla gaṣṣā la-māy

i18n.en: And the deeps of the earth all stood open for one hundred and fifty days; and all the earth stood with its face under the waters.

paragraphs.text: ወቦአ፡ ማይ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ አሐደ፡ ምእተ፡ ወኀምሳ፡ መዓልተ፡ ወወድቀ፡ ላዕለ፡ አድባር፡ ዘአራራት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-boʾa māy lāʿla mədr ʾaḥada məʾəta wa-ḫamsā maʿālta wa-wadqa lāʿla ʾadbār zaʾArārāt

i18n.en: And the waters prevailed upon the earth one hundred and fifty days; and they came down upon the mountains of Ararat.

paragraphs.text: ወአዕረፈት፡ ታቦት፡ ላዕለ፡ ደብር፡ ዘሉብር፡ አሐዱ፡ እምነ፡ አድባር፡ ዘአራራት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿrafat tābot lāʿla dabr zaLubar ʾaḥadu ʾəm-nə ʾadbār zaʾArārāt

i18n.en: And the ark came to rest upon Mount Lubar, one of the mountains of Ararat.

paragraphs.text: ወአልኀጹ፡ ማየ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ወአስተ፡ ነቅዐ፡ ምድር፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ወርኅ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ዕለት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ወርኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾalḫaḍu māya mədr ʾəm-nə mədr wa-ʾasta naqʿa mədr ba-qadāmāwi warḫ ba-qadāmāwi ʿəlat la-zəntu warḫ

i18n.en: And the waters of the earth abated from the earth, and the earth appeared on the first month, on the first day of that month.

paragraphs.text: ወበ፲ ወ፯ ዕለት፡ ለወርኅ፡ ካልእ፡ ይብስ፡ ምድር፡ ወበ፳ ወ፯ ዕለት፡ አርኀወ፡ ኖኅ፡ ታቦት፡ ወወፍአ፡ ለነ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-17 ʿəlat la-warḫ kāləʾ yəbs mədr wa-ba-27 ʿəlat ʾarḫawa Noḫ tābot wa-wafʾa lana

i18n.en: And on the seventeenth day of the second month the earth was dry; and on the twenty-seventh day Noah opened the ark, and looked out from it.

paragraphs.text: ወወፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ታቦት፡ በወርኅ፡ ሣልስ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ለወርኅ፡ በሣልስ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ለወፂኦ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-waḍʾa ʾəm-nə tābot ba-warḫ śāləs ba-qadāmāwi la-warḫ ba-śāləs la-warḫ la-waḍiʾo ʾəm-nə mədr

i18n.en: And he went forth from the ark in the third month, on the first day of the month, on the third day after the appearing of the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወአንተ፡ አዝዝ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀብዋ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ዕለት፡ ለዘ፪ ወርኅ፡ ለዓመተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕገ፡ ኪዳን፡ በከመ፡ ኮነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanta ʾəzəz la-daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl kama yəʿqəbwā la-zāti qadāmāwi ʿəlat la-za-2 warḫ la-ʿāmata kwəlu ḥəga kidān ba-kama kona mawāʿəla Noḫ

i18n.en: And you, command the sons of Israel that they keep this first day of the second month throughout all their generations, as a memorial of the law of the covenant, as it was in the days of Noah.
